create_dataset_instance: create a Video3DTimeGroundTruthDataset instance with a config object and train split for 3D video data
load_metadata_and_poses: load metadata, camera poses, intrinsics, and normalized time values from JSON pose files in the dataset directory
prepare_training_data: prepare training data by collecting coords, RGB, depth, and flow tensors across all images into concatenated tensors
render_spiral_poses: render spiral camera poses using interpolate_poses and create_spiral_poses for novel view synthesis with focus depth
get_item_batch: get a batch dict with coords, RGB, depth, and flow for render, test, val, or train splits by index
